changelog: **Program journey builder (#1853):** `/admin/programs/[id]/journey` (linked from each row of `/admin/cohorts`) lays out a programme's steps in order under optional milestones (`ProgramStep.milestone`, nullable), edited in EN/TR/DE, reordered, published/unpublished and archived (never deleted). The API under `/api/admin/programs/[id]/journey` is ADMIN of the programme's own tenant + `mentorship` capability on every verb (`src/lib/programJourneyAdmin.ts`; another tenant's programme answers 404) and refuses a step the org could never schedule (`stage_not_in_pipeline`, `program_has_no_start`) or an unsafe content link. The dry-run preview (`GET …/journey/preview?relationId=`) renders each step's computed date and what the sweep would do (`journeyStepStatus()`, shared with the participant view) and never writes a `ProgramStepRun`. `GET …/journey` also returns the journey as a template (`journeyTemplate()`: no ids, no dates) for the clone work in #1641/#1643. Unpublishing stops future delivery only.

en: Programme owners can now lay out a journey step by step — a nudge on day 3, a first goal on day 7 — preview the dates for any pair, and publish it.
tr: Program sahipleri artık akışı adım adım kurgulayabilir — 3. günde bir hatırlatma, 7. günde ilk hedef — herhangi bir ikilinin tarihlerini önizleyip yayınlayabilir.
de: Programmverantwortliche können jetzt einen Ablauf Schritt für Schritt anlegen — eine Erinnerung an Tag 3, ein erstes Ziel an Tag 7 —, die Termine für jedes Paar vorab ansehen und ihn veröffentlichen.
